model_annotation: This line plot illustrates how coverage changes with the number of completions (k) for four different models: Llama-3B, Llama-3B + FT, Llama-1B, and Llama-1B + FT. The x-axis, labeled “Number of completions (k)”, uses a logarithmic scale ranging from 2^0 (1) to 2^5 (32), with tick marks at each power of two. The y-axis, labeled “Coverage”, ranges from 0.4 to 0.8 in linear scale. The blue line with circle markers represents Llama-3B, starting at a coverage of 0.4 when k=1 and increasing to 0.85 when k=32. The green line with triangle markers represents Llama-3B + FT, starting at 0.4 when k=1 and increasing to 0.87 when k=32. The light blue line with diamond markers represents Llama-1B, starting at 0.2 when k=1 and increasing to 0.82 when k=32. The light green line with cross markers represents Llama-1B + FT, starting at 0.2 when k=1 and increasing to 0.84 when k=32. All four lines show a generally increasing trend in coverage as k increases, with the Llama-3B + FT model achieving the highest coverage at the highest k value.
